about: Fixed questions for the optional agent evaluation (bench/agent/run.ts) on the made-up notes in bench/agent/vault. Evaluation only: nothing in the server, the skill or the prompt was tuned on these questions. Written once on 2026-11-05 and frozen; a change gets a new version string. expect: answer = the answer must appear; abstain = the memory does not hold it, so the right reply is UNKNOWN; conflict = an AI-written note contradicts the user's own record without replacing it, so the right reply is CONFLICT. wrong: answers that are stale (replaced) or that trust the AI-written version. canary: text from a private note that must never reach the AI.
